answer_1.quote: We consider validating our framework on two challenging dialogue tasks: character-based dialogue ... and target-oriented proactive dialogue ... Our framework is designed to tune LLMs for dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: Our evaluation metrics include word-level F1 (Word F1), BLEU-n, and distinct (DIST) for the LIGHT dataset. For the TOPDIAL dataset, we adopt the Word F1, BLEU-n, and target success rate (Succ.). We also adopt the state-of-the-art LLM, GPT-4, to automatically evaluate the score of dialogue consistency (GPT-4 Score).

answer_3.quote: We take the necessary checking information ... and then ask GPT-4 to rate the consistency with an integer scale of 1 ∼ 10. We also adopt the state-of-the-art LLM, GPT-4, to automatically evaluate the score of dialogue consistency (GPT-4 Score).

answer_4.quote: We used ChatGPT to simulate the roles of different users ... recruit three well-educated graduate students as the annotators to evaluate which one is better (or tied) from the dimensions of consistency (Consist.), proactivity (Proact.), coherence (Coh.), and target success rate (Succ.).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two model variants and judge which is better or tied on consistency, proactivity, coherence, and target success rate.
